test_cache_isolation.rationale: Existing dependency junction otherwise allows different disposable Vite roots to use the same writable dependency cache. This risk is established statically; it is not proven to explain previous render timeouts.

scope: Exact staged application/frontend source; only temporary Vite cache configuration transformed. Real Edge/React uses fictional intercepted HTTP, not a fresh live FastAPI/database execution. No working-tree edits or dependencies installed.
